```python
from seedemu import Emulator, AutonomousSystem, Network, Router, Host, InternetExchange, BgpAttackerComponent, Docker

emu = Emulator()

# Create Autonomous Systems
as150 = AutonomousSystem(150)
as2 = AutonomousSystem(2)
as151 = AutonomousSystem(151)

# AS150: 1 router, 1 network, 1 host
net150 = Network('net150')
router150 = Router('r150')
host150 = Host('h150')
as150.addNetwork(net150)
as150.addRouter(router150)
as150.attach(router150, net150)
as150.attach(host150, net150)

# AS2: 2 routers, 1 network, 1 host
net2 = Network('net2')
router2a = Router('r2a')
router2b = Router('r2b')
host2 = Host('h2')
as2.addNetwork(net2)
as2.addRouter(router2a)
as2.addRouter(router2b)
as2.attach(router2a, net2)
as2.attach(router2b, net2)
as2.attach(host2, net2)

# AS151: 1 router, 1 network, 1 host
net151 = Network('net151')
router151 = Router('r151')
host151 = Host('h151')
as151.addNetwork(net151)
as151.addRouter(router151)
as151.attach(router151, net151)
as151.attach(host151, net151)

# Add ASes to emulator
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as150)
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as2)
emu.addAutonomousSystem(as151)

# Create Internet Exchanges
ix100 = InternetExchange(100)
ix101 = InternetExchange(101)
emu.addInternetExchange(ix100)
emu.addInternetExchange(ix101)

# Join routers to IXes
ix100.join(router150)
ix100.join(router2a)
ix101.join(router2b)
ix101.join(router151)

# BGP Attacker: hijacks AS151's prefix, joins IX100
attacker = BgpAttackerComponent()
attacker.setHijackerAsn(65000)
attacker.addHijackedPrefix(as151.getPrefixes()[0])
attacker.joinInternetExchange(100)
emu.addComponent(attacker)

# Private peerings
emu.addPrivatePeering(150, 2, 100)
emu.addPrivatePeering(151, 2, 101)
emu.addPrivatePeering(65000, 2, 100)

# Merge attacker component
emu.merge(attacker)

# Render and compile with Docker, internal network management
emu.render()
emu.compile(Docker(), manageNetworkInternally=True)
```
